architecture.deletion_owner: retention predicate, current registry policy and shared PayloadLocks/WorkflowReaders.
architecture.git_membership_owner: _git_proof.py checks commit/tree/blob membership independently of generic content identity. It uses existing registry and snapshot transport, without another queue or PublicationReceipt field.
architecture.location_and_policy_authority: StorageRegistry owns inventory, local bindings, preferences, proof indexes and pending-source protection.
architecture.ordinary_resolution_owner: LocalArtifactStore; RunFetcher delegates persistent payload resolution.
architecture.proof_authority: Immutable snapshot, individual-file and Git-membership proofs cover distinct facts. Registry records are hash-checked indexes.
architecture.publication_intent_authority: Operation and PublicationJob own publication intent and collection closure, not current retention decisions.
architecture.retired_duplicate_owner: JEP csts_pilot/background_storage.py independent publication queue removed; Viper owns publication and retry.
architecture.scope_note: No additional competing authority found in this bounded review. Functional reviews and release validation are separate.

method.baseline_files: Immutable Git tree/blob contents reread at the exact recorded commits.
method.current_files: Existing cached and nonignored untracked Python paths; deleted paths excluded.
excluded: Generated bytecode and ignored temporary files
method.no_credit: Retired planning mirrors receive no runtime or test reduction credit.

previous_checkpoint_counts.note: Retained only as the earlier count checkpoint; not the current totals.

reduction_requirement.reason: Maintained runtime and test Python line totals both grew across the repositories.

remaining_nonblocking_consolidation.constraint: Preserve fresh full-byte verification versus reuse of committed proof, legacy synchronous guarantees, and no remote reverification during later cleanup.
